blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Camarines Sur has taken a major step toward expanding its renewable energy capacity following the installation of the first wind turbine of the 58.5-megawatt (MW) Libmanan Wind Power Project. Gov. Luis Raymund (Lray) Villafuerte Jr. said it marked the culmination of years of effort to develop the province’s wind energy resources, saying that discussions regarding wind energy began during the administration of the late President Fidel V. Ramos. Cornerstone Energy Development Inc. (CEDI), now a subsidiary of AboitizPower, was among the project’s original proponents, he said.
